citation.sourceDocument: SSA, Cost-of-Living Increase and Other Determinations for 2026, 90 FR (Nov. 3, 2025); 42 U.S.C. §§403(b), (f), 402(q)(7)
citation.sourceNote: SSA's notice: "The lower annual exempt amount is $24,480 under the retirement earnings test" and "The higher annual exempt amount is $65,160". "For beneficiaries who attain NRA in the year, we withhold $1 in benefits for every $3 of earnings over the annual exempt amount for months before NRA. For all other beneficiaries under NRA, we withhold $1 in benefits for every $2 of earnings over the annual exempt amount." 42 U.S.C. §402(q)(7)(A) leaves any month whose benefit was withheld under §403(b) out of the reduction period, so the benefit is recomputed upward at full retirement age. Read from the Federal Register because ssa.gov refuses this pipeline. Read 2026-10-19; re-read 2026-10-20 in the notice's full text, unchanged.
